# `modules/EditorAI.js`

> **Source:** `editor/js/modules/EditorAI.js`

EditorAI.js - AI, Navigation, Steering, and Behavior Trees for Editor Extracted from EditorPhysics.js for modularity

## Functions

### `getOrCreateNavGrid(options = {})`

Initialize or get the editor's navigation grid

**Parameters:**

- `options` *(Object)* — Grid options

**Returns:** Navigation grid

### `findPath(start, goal, options = {})`

Find a path between two world positions

### `updateNavGridFromColliders(colliders, walkable = false)`

Mark cells as blocked/walkable based on colliders

### `smoothPath(waypoints, smoothing = 0.5)`

Smooth a path using string-pulling

### `getPathSteering(currentPos, waypoints, lookahead = 1.0)`

Get steering direction to follow a path

### `getNavGridVisualization()`

Debug: visualize nav grid walkability

### `createAIAgent(options = {})`

Create an AI agent with steering behaviors

### `updateAIAgent(agent, behaviors, dt)`

Update AI agent with combined steering behaviors

### `createFlock(count, options = {})`

Create a flock of AI agents

### `updateFlock(agents, dt, options = {})`

Update entire flock with flocking behavior

### `createPatrolBehavior(waypoints)`

Create a simple patrol behavior tree

### `createChaseFleeBehavior(chaseRadius = 10, fleeHealth = 20)`

Create a chase/flee behavior tree

### `tickBehaviorTree(tree, blackboard, dt)`

Run a behavior tree tick

### `createAIPerception(options = {})`

Create an AI perception component

### `canSee(perception, position, forward, targetPos)`

Check if an entity can see a target

### `canHear(perception, position, soundPos, soundVolume = 1)`

Check if an entity can hear a sound

### `updateAIPerception(perception, position, forward, entities, dt)`

Update perception - detect nearby entities

### `getLastKnownPosition(perception, entityId)`

Get last known position of an entity

## Notes & Examples

### Editor Extension System

The editor supports extensions via the same Plauna component system as apps. Extensions can add panels, tools, menu items, and hooks into the engine. They run with elevated 'editor' capability granting access to the scene graph, asset database, and build pipeline.

**Example: Editor extension adding a custom panel**
```js
import { Extension } from 'editor/core/Extension.js';
import { Panel } from 'editor/ui/Panel.js';

class TerrainEditor extends Extension {
  id = 'terrain-editor';
  capabilities = ['editor', 'scene'];
  
  activate(context) {
    // Add menu item
    context.menus.add('Tools/Terrain', () => this.open());
    
    // Register tool
    context.tools.register('terrain', {
      icon: 'mountain',
      onSelect: (entity) => this.edit(entity)
    });
  }
  
  open() {
    this.panel = new Panel({
      title: 'Terrain Editor',
      content: this.buildUI()
    });
    context.workspace.addPanel(this.panel);
  }
  
  edit(entity) {
    const terrain = entity.get(TerrainComponent);
    this.panel.bind(terrain);
  }
}

editor.extensions.register(TerrainEditor);
```
